title: Stone Soup documentation and tutorials
summary: Official docs for the Stone Soup tracking framework with step-by-step tutorials from a single-target Kalman filter through data association (PDA, JPDA), multi-hypothesis tracking, GM-PHD, track initiation/deletion, sensor management and performance metrics.
key_takeaways: Tutorials double as a self-paced multi-target tracking course
Metrics module (OSPA, SIAP) gives defensible evaluation numbers
Sensor and simulator components let you test without real radar

title: Stone Soup: No Longer Just an Appetiser
authors: Stone Soup team (Dstl, University of Liverpool and partners)
summary: FUSION 2023 paper announcing Stone Soup version 1.0, describing the framework's stable architecture and its use across the tracking community.
key_takeaways: Marks the stable 1.0 API
Background on why defence labs backed an open tracking testbed

title: MIT 2.680 Unmanned Marine Vehicle Autonomy, Sensing and Communications
summary: MIT course site with lectures and hands-on labs built on MOOS-IvP, covering behaviour-based autonomy, multi-vehicle coordination, collision avoidance and marine sensing.
key_takeaways: Lab sequence is a ready MOOS-IvP onboarding path
Includes COLREGs-style collision avoidance behaviours

title: MOOS-IvP documentation wiki
summary: Documentation hub for MOOS-IvP with install guides, the IvP Helm manual, behaviour and app references and example missions.
key_takeaways: Helm manual explains multi-objective behaviour arbitration
Mission files are simple text, quick to adapt

title: COLREGs - Convention on the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea, 1972
summary: IMO page for the collision regulations that define give-way and stand-on duties, lights and signals; the rule set autonomous surface vessels must encode.
key_takeaways: Rules 13-17 (overtaking, head-on, crossing) drive most USV avoidance logic
Rules are written for human judgement, which makes formalization hard

title: ITU-R M.1371 - Technical characteristics for an automatic identification system using TDMA in the VHF maritime mobile band
summary: The ITU recommendation defining AIS radio, TDMA access and message formats that decoders such as pyais implement.
key_takeaways: Defines message types 1-27 decoded by pyais and AIS-catcher
AIS is unauthenticated, so spoofing detection is an open problem

title: Signal K Specification
summary: Published Signal K specification describing the JSON data model, REST and streaming APIs for marine data.
key_takeaways: Defines navigation.* paths for position, attitude and speed
WebSocket delta stream is easy to consume from any language

title: ArduSub documentation
summary: User and developer documentation for ArduSub, covering ROV configuration, sensors, and integration of external positioning such as DVL and USBL via MAVLink.
key_takeaways: Explains how external position sources feed the EKF on a sub
Good companion to BlueOS extensions

title: Water Linked documentation (DVL and Underwater GPS)
summary: Vendor documentation for Water Linked DVLs and Underwater GPS (USBL-style) systems, including the JSON-over-TCP and serial protocols.
key_takeaways: DVL reports velocity and dead-reckoning over JSON/TCP
Check firmware version against protocol version

title: Autoware documentation
summary: Official Autoware documentation with architecture, installation, tutorials and design notes for localization, perception and planning components.
key_takeaways: Localization design docs explain NDT plus EKF fusion
Planning simulator tutorial runs without hardware

title: RELLIS-3D Dataset: Data, Benchmarks and Analysis
summary: Paper introducing the RELLIS-3D multimodal off-road dataset with annotated lidar and images and baseline results.
key_takeaways: Off-road semantics differ sharply from urban datasets
Includes GNSS/IMU for localization work

title: Wild Visual Navigation: Fast Traversability Learning via Pre-Trained Models and Online Self-Supervision
authors: Mattamala, Frey et al., ETH Zurich / Oxford
summary: Describes learning visual traversability online from pre-trained features and robot experience, adapting within minutes in forests and grassland.
key_takeaways: Self-supervision removes manual traversability labels
Pre-trained vision features make online learning feasible

title: Loco Positioning System documentation
summary: Bitcraze documentation for its UWB positioning system covering anchor placement, two-way ranging versus TDoA modes and configuration with Crazyflies.
key_takeaways: TDoA scales to many tags, TWR is simpler
Anchor geometry dominates accuracy

title: UTIL: UWB TDoA dataset
authors: University of Toronto Dynamic Systems Lab
summary: Project page for a UWB TDoA dataset collected with Loco Positioning hardware, with ground truth for evaluating indoor UWB localization.
key_takeaways: Real UWB data including non-line-of-sight effects
Useful to benchmark estimators before buying hardware

title: Crazyswarm2 documentation
summary: Docs for Crazyswarm2 with installation, simulation backends, swarm configuration and tutorials.
key_takeaways: Simulation mode lets you prototype swarm logic on a laptop

title: Onboard Ranging-based Relative Localization and Stability for Lightweight Aerial Swarms
authors: Shushuai Li et al. (TU Delft MAVLab)
summary: Presents onboard UWB ranging with an EKF for relative localization among small quadrotors, with a stability analysis of formation control built on those estimates.
key_takeaways: Relative localization needs no anchors
Observability depends on relative motion between agents

title: Swarm-SLAM: Sparse Decentralized Collaborative Simultaneous Localization and Mapping Framework for Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Paper behind Swarm-SLAM, focusing on sparse inter-robot communication and decentralized loop closure selection.
key_takeaways: Budgeted loop-closure exchange keeps bandwidth low
Works across lidar, stereo and RGB-D

title: DCL-SLAM: A Distributed Collaborative LiDAR SLAM Framework for a Robotic Swarm
summary: Describes a fully distributed lidar C-SLAM using compact descriptors for inter-robot place recognition.
key_takeaways: Compact LiDAR-Iris descriptors reduce data exchange

title: Anti-UAV: A Large Multi-Modal Benchmark for UAV Tracking
summary: Introduces the Anti-UAV RGB and thermal infrared video benchmark for UAV tracking and an evaluation protocol.
key_takeaways: Thermal IR matters for night and small-target tracking
Targets frequently disappear, so trackers must handle absence

title: Anti-UAV Challenge
summary: Site for the recurring Anti-UAV workshop and challenge with tracks for single and multiple UAV tracking in infrared video.
key_takeaways: Leaderboards give a reference point for hackathon results

title: Drone Security and the Mysterious Case of DJI's DroneID
authors: Schiller et al., Ruhr University Bochum / CISPA
summary: Security analysis of DJI drones that reverse-engineers the DroneID broadcast and shows it is unencrypted, with an open receiver released.
key_takeaways: DroneID leaks drone and pilot position in the clear
Decoding needs SDR captures at high sample rates

title: FAA Remote ID for drone pilots
summary: FAA overview of the US Remote ID rule, broadcast modules and compliance, the regulatory backdrop for cooperative drone detection.
key_takeaways: Standard Remote ID broadcasts drone and control station location
Non-compliant drones need non-cooperative detection
